coordinateAndTimeConventions.height: metres above reference sphere, not geoid or Earth sea level
coordinateAndTimeConventions.polarProjection: south polar stereographic, central meridian 0, unit scale at pole, x=easting, y north toward 0 E
coordinateAndTimeConventions.orientation: DE421 MOON_ME for DEM products; other dataset equivalence unresolved
coordinateAndTimeConventions.epochs: Static topography; PDS source interval/version in S04. LCROSS event UTC in S09. Catalog time support [2026-01-01T00:00:00Z,2028-01-01T00:00:00Z), 1 h forcing. No new ephemeris queries.

results.claim: Polar metadata uses height in metres, a 1737400 m sphere and DE421 mean-Earth frame
results.scope: Primary product/GeoTIFF metadata, not an accuracy determination
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: Capture NASA PGDA 90/81 and USGS; decode four original COG IFDs including area registration, metric units and sphere axes.
results.tolerance: Exact metadata values; no positional tolerance asserted
results.limitations: Pixel spacing is distinct from effective resolution/error. GeoTIFF projection labels alone do not establish a frame transform.

results.claim: Thirteen un-clamped polar samples reproduce primary COG heights within encoding tolerance
results.scope: Bounded transfer/resampling check: one 5 m patch, one 10 m patch, one 40 m patch and one 1280 m overview
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: Read original 2x2 COG windows at declared projected pixel centres; independent scalar bilinear interpolation versus decoded bundled heights. Exact HTTP range bodies replay offline.
results.tolerance: Fine grids: 0.0551 m = 0.005 m decimal rounding + 0.05 m packing + 0.0001 m arithmetic allowance. Overview: 0.2001 m = 0.05 + 0.15 + 0.0001 m.
results.limitations: Sampling is deliberately small, not all pixels or an independent measurement. Two requested points lie beyond original support and are excluded, never counted as passes.

results.claim: Uniform patch coordinates disagree with the upsampling edge-replicated source sample
results.scope: Existing fine40 odysseus grid final index 263168; overview edge also extends beyond source-centre support
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: Compare source interpolation at metadata coordinate with bundled last node, then evaluate builder cutout edge clamp to isolate cause.
results.tolerance: 0.0551 m fixed encoding bound; no physical terrain tolerance invented
results.limitations: Public data read-only. Parent must authorize reproducible regeneration with a source-pixel halo or a correctly registered resampler; changing global spacing would misregister the interior. No whole-map error claim.

results.claim: Global height calibration and five downsampled cells match original PDS DN values
results.scope: LDEM_16 V3.1, original 5760x2880 pixel-registered cylindrical grid, output 2560x1280
results.referenceVersion: PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0; LDEM_16 V3.1 created 2019-03-15; input observations 2009-07-13T17:33:17 to 2016-11-29T05:48:19 (source label times).
results.method: Fresh label matches bundled label SHA256. Bounded IMG row ranges decoded little-endian signed int16; independent integer quarter-pixel overlap weights reproduce five selected output DNs. Packed/decoded whole bundled hashes verified.
results.tolerance: 0 DN difference for selected rounded output; 0.5 m DN scale; height = DN*0.5 m; radius = height+1737400 m
results.limitations: Full upstream IMG hash recorded in bundle metadata was not recomputed from a complete fresh download. Native coordinate-area average is not a spherical area integral.

results.claim: A Malapert regional slope stencil agrees with primary heights at the stated scale
results.scope: lat -85.99985841143967 deg, lon 359.99670036862335 deg east; DE421 ME; source 10 m, output 23.976608187134502 m projected
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: Four original COG stencil heights, independent central differences and stereographic metric correction, versus regionalSlope on bundled heights.
results.tolerance: 0.1864364403885588 deg upper arithmetic bound from atan Lipschitz bound and 0.0551 m per-height encoding error; not source slope accuracy
results.limitations: One regional stencil does not validate vehicle footprint slopes, rocks, regolith or PGDA slope-error maps. Source interpolation errors are not covered by this tolerance.

results.claim: Coarse horizon reproduces analytic spherical dip under its discrete ray policy
results.scope: Synthetic sphere R=1737400 m, observer 2 m, north-clockwise ENU azimuth; no epoch
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: Compare all 180 rays with closed-form tangent dip -acos(R/(R+h)). Also check angular interpolation across north and NaN sectors.
results.tolerance: 0.001 deg algorithm-only test bound, declared before execution
results.limitations: Synthetic-only formula verification; never physical skyline validation. 200 log distances from 1 to 1000000 m and 2 deg azimuth can miss ridges.

results.claim: LCROSS marker agrees with original NASA-hosted impact-location paper
results.scope: Centaur 2009-10-09T11:31:19.506 UTC; Mean Earth selenocentric degrees east longitude/latitude
results.method: Fresh NASA PDF bytes match pinned original SHA256 and byte length; pdftotext confirms published coordinates and impact UTC. Runtime keeps abundance/extent null.
results.tolerance: Exact factual transcription; reported location uncertainty 115 m latitude, 44 m longitude (1 sigma), not pixel resolution
results.limitations: Location paper is not independent remeasurement of water abundance or deposit shape. Ejecta-water detection cannot characterize nearby excavatable resources.

results.claim: Prepared-mask pipeline can return a finite horizon after skipping unknown terrain
results.scope: Unchanged pipeline/build_dataset.py horizon_masks; synthetic unknown-on-ray case
results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256
results.method: AST-execute original pure functions without decorators; both DEMs missing a near ray location, >=8 remaining samples. Ray remains finite.
results.tolerance: Unknown crossing should remain unknown unless a justified conservative occlusion bound is supplied
results.limitations: Pipeline belongs to ephemeris lane. This demonstrates policy failure, not that a specific bundled ray was affected; original DEM nodata prevalence unavailable.

results.claim: Exposure/slope ranking and ice markers do not establish safety or recoverable reserves

results.referenceVersion: Captured 2026-11-15; see references/responses.json for UTC, ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256

acceptance: Not accepted as an all-green scientific audit: failing and uncertain findings remain. Passing tests reproduce discrepancies as well as formula behavior; no operational certification.
